name: 珊瑚橙街头双翘滑板款
description: 珊瑚橙开场、白底主图、街头滑行、砂纸桥架微距、分层结构与多色板面的双翘滑板套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: sunset coral gradient #E8795A to #F29A76 for cover and campaign shots, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, light neutral grey for detail shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm-toned studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft controlled contact shadows, golden-hour directional light for outdoor scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth concrete plaza #B9B4AE outdoors, matte neutral studio board #EDEDED indoors
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines with small uppercase Latin sub-labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles, single amber-orange accent #F08519
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent board scale across the set; full board always shown with trucks and wheels intact
noDrift: no visible brand marks or printed deck artwork from any reference
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent youthful street-sports ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sunset coral gradient #E8795A to #F29A76, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2B2B2B, and one amber-orange accent #F08519; warm-toned studio lighting with a front-left key and soft controlled contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and numbered circles with thin-line icons; clean dynamic product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent board scale, full board always shown with trucks and wheels intact and balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible brand marks or printed deck artwork from any reference.

shots.intent: 一秒建立街头运动氛围与核心主张，赢取点击
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward, slight 3/4 board attitude, full board visible
shots.lighting: warm front-left key with a soft rim light, soft grounded shadow beneath the board
shots.props: two palm leaves entering from the frame edges, not covering the product
shots.textZone: upper third headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with a smaller sub-line 「{callout_2}」 below it, kept clear of the board silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Dynamic e-commerce campaign cover of {product} floating mid-air. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward, slight 3/4 board attitude, full board visible with all four wheels, filling 50-60% of the frame in the lower two-thirds. Warm front-left key light with a soft rim, soft grounded shadow beneath the board. Sunset coral gradient background #E8795A to #F29A76 with two palm-leaf props entering from the frame edges, not covering the product. The upper third carries the typography: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and a smaller sub-line 「{callout_2}」 below it, sized so the type never overlaps the board. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no QR code, no garbled text, no extra props, no hands, no cut-off wheels.

shots.intent: 平台合规白底主图，完整板型轮廓一眼看清
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, eye-level, full board visible with both kicktails
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean 90-degree side profile, eye-level, full board visible with both kicktails and all four wheels, not clipped by the frame, filling 60-70% of the frame with balanced margins on all sides. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow under the wheels grounding the board. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 代入刷街自由感，让买家投射自己上板的画面
shots.camera: low tracking angle at wheel height, board rolling toward the camera, rider cropped below the shoulders
shots.lighting: warm golden-hour directional light from the left, 5200K, long soft shadows
shots.background: smooth outdoor concrete plaza #B9B4AE, softly blurred depth
shots.props: plain skate helmet and protective pads worn by the rider (face not visible)
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the open plaza ahead and the softly blurred depth
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} rolling on a smooth outdoor concrete plaza at dusk. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low tracking angle at wheel height, the board rolling toward the camera with a slight motion feel, rider cropped below the shoulders wearing a plain helmet and protective pads, face not visible. Warm golden-hour directional light from the left, 5200K, long soft shadows. Weathered concrete surface #B9B4AE with softly blurred depth. The board occupies 40-50% of the frame, with the open plaza ahead giving natural breathing room. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the board, no brand logos on gear, no text or captions, no watermark, no crowded background, no deformed limbs.

shots.intent: 交代板长板宽与关键参数，消除尺寸疑虑
shots.camera: directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, board vertical in frame
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: thin dimension lines and two solid rounded label chips
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the board and the dimension lines
shots.textZone: dimension lines with end ticks plus two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, board vertical in frame and enlarged to fill 65-75% of the frame. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Clean white background #FFFFFF. Thin dimension lines with end ticks in #2B2B2B and one coral #E8795A accent line marking the board length, with two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B on solid rounded label chips, the whole layout held by about 15% panel margins. Clean structured layout. Negative: no dense body text, no fabricated dimensions or numbers, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用防滑砂纸颗粒质感证明板面工艺与安全性
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, raking low side angle along the deck edge, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing grit texture, controlled highlight
shots.background: grip-tape surface fills the frame; backdrop neutral matte board #EDEDED
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the grip-tape surface and deck edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a raking low side angle along the deck edge so the texture reads diagonally, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the gritty sand texture, controlled highlight, no blown speculars. The grip-tape surface fills the frame with a neutral matte board backdrop #EDEDED. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with minimal margin, the grit texture itself is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated texture, no text or annotations, no watermark, no logo, no props.

shots.intent: 特写桥架与 PU 轮做工，证明转向顺滑与用材扎实
shots.camera: close-up detail shot from a very low angle looking upward at wheel height
shots.lighting: soft directional studio light from the front-left, one controlled specular on the wheel, soft shadow
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B with a thin leader line
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product}, tight zoom on the truck and wheel assembly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at wheel height, the truck and wheel crisp and centered. Soft directional studio light from the front-left with one controlled specular on the wheel and a soft shadow below. Light grey seamless background #F4F5F7. The truck-and-wheel detail occupies 50-55% of the frame with balanced margins. One short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B connected to the truck by a thin leader line. Negative: no blurry subject, no extra or duplicated wheels, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no floating parts, no impossible reflections.

shots.intent: 用拆层示意讲清板体叠层结构工艺，支撑品质主张
shots.camera: deck layers separated along a 45-degree diagonal, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down
shots.lighting: soft even studio light with gentle layer-to-layer shadows
shots.props: numbered circles 1-5 as infographic markers, right-side list panel
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the layered diagram and the list panel
shots.textZone: right column of five short claim labels 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_5}」 in #FFFFFF aligned to numbered circles
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce exploded-structure infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Deck layers separated and floating along a 45-degree diagonal, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, the layered diagram filling 65-75% of the frame. Soft even studio light with gentle layer-to-layer shadows. Sunset coral background #E8795A. Numbered circles 1 to 5 in #FFFFFF with amber #F08519 accents, and a right-side column of five short claim labels 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_5}」 in #FFFFFF aligned to the numbers, the whole layout held by about 15% panel margins. Clean structured layout. Negative: no invented material percentages or lab data, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并列展示不同板面花色，让买家按喜好选择
shots.camera: three board finish variants in a staggered diagonal row, each at the identical slight 3/4 hero angle
shots.lighting: identical warm studio lighting across all variants, soft contact shadows
shots.background: light grey product tiles #E3E3E3 with white label panels beside each variant
shots.textZone: one short label per variant 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2B2B2B on the white label panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant lineup of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three board finish variants from the product reference placed in a staggered diagonal row, each photographed at the identical slight 3/4 hero angle with identical warm studio lighting and soft contact shadows. Light grey product tiles #E3E3E3 with white rounded label panels beside each variant carrying short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2B2B2B. The boards occupy 60-65% of the frame overall with the label panels filling the remaining space in a tight grid. Negative: no lighting drift between variants, no duplicated identical boards, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cut-off wheels.

shots.intent: 以砂纸板面、桥架与轮组的可视做工细节配短标签降风险，不虚构任何资质
shots.camera: clean straight-on eye-level view, board centered
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B beside the board
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The board shown clean at a straight-on eye-level view and centered, filling 50-60% of the frame, with its coarse grip-tape grain, solid aluminum trucks and smooth PU wheels rendered in crisp detail as the visible trust focus. Pure white background #FFFFFF, even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow. Two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B sit beside the board. Clean structured layout. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, test data, ratings or awards, no fabricated badges or seals, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text.

shots.intent: 珊瑚橙收口，承接优惠与行动号召
shots.camera: dynamic slight 3/4 low angle, board angled with forward motion energy
shots.lighting: punchier warm key light from the front-left, soft grounded shadow
shots.props: one solid rounded offer badge in #F08519
shots.textZone: short CTA label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF plus one solid rounded offer badge in #F08519 with a short label 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Dynamic slight 3/4 low angle with the board angled to convey forward motion energy, full board visible, filling 50-60% of the frame in the upper two-thirds. Punchier warm key light from the front-left, soft grounded shadow. Sunset coral gradient background #E8795A to #F29A76. The lower third carries the conversion block: a short CTA label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF above one solid rounded offer badge in #F08519 with a short label 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no invented discounts or countdown numbers, no QR code, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text, no cut-off wheels.

provenance.notes: 从 10 张爆款双翘滑板详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌 logo 与书法字、板面涂鸦印刷图案、乱码模板文案（如 500CM、cup cover）、二维码与会员徽章、以及 0.21KG/7-9 倍钢强度等不可证实数据（改用 {callout_n} 占位）。源封面图为另一块带品牌 logo 的黑色小鱼板，与主体产品不一致，仅保留其珊瑚橙封面视觉语法并换用主产品占位。产品一律以 {product} 占位，人物仅保留滑手角色（不露脸、佩戴护具）。
